title: tcp: more tests that tcpd is non-null
description:
Add more tests that `struct tcp_analysis *tcpd` is not `NULL`.

Functions like `decode_tcp_ports()` may be called with a null `tcpd`
parameter, and functions like `get_tcp_conversation_data_idempotent()`
may return `NULL`.

More checks could still be added. We could add `DISSECTOR_ASSERT()`
checks to functions which expect non-null `tcpd` parameters, for
example.

Closes #20018

notes.body: It looks like @AndersBroman already addressed this in e0c49a857373267c17ff7daef0e1a840b9897116.
